A place set apart

Still waters.
Open hearts.

Mar Thoma Dhyanatheeram is envisioned as a holistic meditation and retreat centre where nature, faith and community meet.

Located at Perungalam beside Ashtamudi Lake and close to Munroe Island, the centre welcomes individuals, families and groups seeking rest, spiritual renewal and deeper connection.

The modernization project

A thoughtful new chapter
by the water.

The development plan brings together renewed retreat facilities, landscaped gathering spaces and distinctive lakeside accommodation—designed to serve the Church and the wider community for years to come.

01

Floating cottages

Three twin cottages create a memorable stay on the lake, bringing guests closer to the landscape and its stillness.

⌂ 02

Renewed retreat spaces

Comfortable accommodation and shared spaces for prayer, study and fellowship.

◌ 03

Landscape & gathering

Gardens, walking paths and outdoor areas that invite quiet and conversation.

Rooted in faith

Hospitality with
a deeper purpose.

Dhyanatheeram is a project of the Mar Thoma Syrian Church, Thiruvananthapuram–Kollam Diocese. Its vision is guided by a tradition of worship, service and care for creation.

“Come and immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Ashtamudi Lake and Munroe Island.”
